recent_articles.title: India, Canada launch trade & investment forum - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Goyal**, during his recent trade missions to Canada and the United States, emphasized the importance of enhancing connectivity and fostering business partnerships. He met with **Canadian International Trade Minister Maninder Sidhu**, business leaders in both countries, and prominent figures like **Ted Pick** (Morgan Stanley) and **Chip Kaye** (Warburg Pincus).  These engagements focused on expanding trade, investment, innovation, and supply chain collaborations to drive shared prosperity between the nations.

recent_articles.title: Rajasthan Cabinet approves new industrial development policy with focus on talent economy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Rajasthan** Cabinet approved a new industrial development policy focused on talent economy and private sector participation to create a world-class industrial infrastructure.  **Industries and Commerce Minister Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore** stated the policy would provide incentives for micro, small, and medium enterprises, one district one product, and the export sector. The policy aims to boost the state's economy to $350 billion by 2028-29.  The Cabinet also approved decisions on energy production, water conservation, and pensioners' welfare.

recent_articles.title: After High Court verdict, Hindu petitioners seek free entry for devotees at Bhojshala in Madhya Pradesh - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Hindu** petitioners have filed applications with the **Archaeological Survey of India (ASI)** and the **Union Culture Ministry**, demanding free entry to the Bhojshala complex and the removal of "unauthorised Islamic symbols". They also requested that idols of Lord Hanuman and other Hindu deities be retrieved through a scientific excavation. The **Madhya Pradesh High Court** had declared the site a Vagdevi temple on May 15, quashing an earlier order allowing Muslims to offer namaz there.

recent_articles.title: Six missing after boat capsizes in Yamuna in U.P.’s Hamirpur; search underway - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Six** people, including children, went missing after a boat capsized in the Yamuna river on Wednesday evening. **Three** individuals were rescued by the boatman, while the remaining six remain unaccounted for.  The **District Magistrate**, **Chief Minister Adityanath**, and **BJP MLA Manoj Prajapati** have ordered rescue efforts to locate the missing persons. The **National Disaster Response Force** and **State Disaster Response Force** are assisting in the search.

recent_articles.title: Vedanta's demerged entities to trade by mid-June after split, says CEO - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vedanta Resources CEO Deshnee Naidoo** and **CFO Ajay Goel** announced that the demerger of the company into five independent sector-specific pure play companies is nearing completion. The demerger, effective May 1, will see shareholders receive four additional shares for each share held in Vedanta as of April 29th.  The listing and commencement of trading are expected by mid-June with **Vedanta Ltd.**'s board approval already in place. The demerger aims to simplify the company's structure and provide opportunities for global investors.

recent_articles.title: India, New Zealand to sign FTA on April 27; deal provides Indian exporters 100% duty-free access - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India** and **New Zealand** will sign a Free Trade Agreement (FTA) on Monday, April 27, 2026. The agreement will remove tariffs on 100% of India's exports to New Zealand and either reduce or eliminate tariffs on 95% of current imports from New Zealand. Commerce Minister **Piyush Goyal** welcomed **Todd McClay**, New Zealand’s Minister for Trade & Investment, to New Delhi ahead of the signing ceremony. The FTA is one of the fastest-negotiated trade agreements India has entered into and includes provisions for student mobility, professional visas, and investment from New Zealand in India.

recent_articles.title: Export disruption hits ‘Bangalore Rose’ onion farmers; MP seeks urgent support - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **K. Sudhakar**, MP for Chickballapur, has urged the **Union government** to intervene in the market distress faced by farmers cultivating the geographically indicated (GI) ‘Bangalore Rose’ onion. The onion's export-oriented nature has been disrupted due to geopolitical issues, leading to a sharp decline in prices and financial hardship for farmers.  **Dr. Sudhakar** has called for procurement interventions, alternative export markets, logistical support, and processing infrastructure development under the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Sampada Yojana (PMKSY) to address the crisis.

recent_articles.title: No woman will be happy with DMK, Congress: Piyush Goyal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Piyush Goyal**, Union Minister for Commerce and Industries, criticized the **DMK-Congress** decision to defeat the women's reservation Bill, calling it a divisive move that further divides India.  He praised **Amit Shah**, Union Home Minister, who offered to increase seats in the state by 50% during Parliament discussions. Goyal emphasized Prime Minister Narendra Modi's commitment to inclusive development across all states and regions of India.

recent_articles.title: Modi should not play with ‘fire’, warns Stalin over delimitation issue - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **M.K. Stalin**, president of the **DMK**, cautioned **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Union Minister Piyush Goyal** against making disrespectful remarks about Tamil Nadu and its people during his campaign for the Assembly elections. He expressed concern over proposed delimitation exercises, stating they could negatively impact progressive states like Tamil Nadu.  He criticized **Edappadi K. Palaniswami**, leader of the opposition, for his perceived lack of understanding of Dravidian ideology and accused the BJP of attempting to gain a foothold in Tamil Nadu by using the AIADMK as a "mask".

recent_articles.title: Delimitation will not affect southern States, says Goyal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Piyush Goyal**, Union Commerce and Industry Minister, stated that the 33% reservation for women in Parliament and Assemblies will be implemented by 2029. He dismissed concerns about potential disadvantages to southern states, arguing that the increase is proportional nationwide. **M.K. Stalin**, Tamil Nadu Chief Minister, and others have been accused of promoting a false narrative on this issue.

recent_articles.title: Piyush Goyal interview | 'Delimitation will not affect southern States' - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Piyush Goyal**, Union Minister for Commerce and Industry, defended the allocation of the first PM Mitra Park to Tamil Nadu, stating that if **the Narendra Modi government** were engaging in petty politics, it would have chosen a state under its control.  He clarified that the BJP government had previously sanctioned the park in Virudhunagar during his tenure as Textiles Minister.

recent_articles.title: Tamil Nadu election 2026: If BJP were playing petty politics, State would not have got first PM Mitra Park, says Piyush Goyal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Piyush Goyal**, **Union Minister for Commerce and Industry**, defended the government's proposed delimitation plan, stating that it would not disadvantage southern states. He refuted allegations of political motives, claiming the allocation of the first PM Mitra Park to Tamil Nadu was a non-issue compared to the broader national context.  **Goyal** also assured that the government would implement 33% reservation for women by 2029.

recent_articles.title: Prominent candidates in Chennai file nomination papers, set out to canvass votes - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Several candidates filed their nomination papers for the Tamil Nadu Assembly election on Monday, April 6, 2026. **Piyush Goyal**, accompanied by members of the BJP and AIADMK, supported **Tamilisai Soundararajan**'s bid for the Mylapore Taluk office.  **B. Valarmathi**, former Minister and AIADMK candidate for Thousand Lights, highlighted civic grievances in the constituency. **Aassan Maulaana**, Congress candidate for Velachery, will face off against M.K. Ashok of the AIADMK. **Ma. recent_articles.title: Prominent candidates file nomination papers, set out to canvass votes - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Several candidates filed their nomination papers for the Tamil Nadu Assembly election on Monday. **Tamilisai Soundararajan**, former **Telangana Governor** and **BJP leader**, submitted her papers in Mylapore, accompanied by **Piyush Goyal**.  **B. recent_articles.title: T.N. Assembly election: Why aren’t you implementing the Centre’s schemes, Piyush Goyal questions M.K. Stalin - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Piyush Goyal**, **Union Minister for Commerce and Industry**, criticized **Chief Minister M.K. Stalin** during a press conference in Chennai, alleging corruption in sand mining, Tasmac, and drug proliferation in Tamil Nadu. He questioned why the state government was not implementing central government schemes and claimed that over 70% of DMK's promises remained unfulfilled.  Goyal also accused the DMK of hindering development by refusing to collaborate with the **Prime Minister Modi**-led government.

recent_articles.title: As U.S. sanctions deadlines expire this month, exporters urge government to revive oil-rice barter trade mechanism with Iran - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Indian** government's decision to resume oil and LNG imports from **Iran** after a seven-year hiatus has sparked hopes for restoring trade with the country, including its interest in the Chabahar port.  While U.S. sanctions deadlines loom, the government remains engaged with all parties on the issue of Chabahar and is exploring barter agreements with Iran to ease India's oil crisis. The **Punjab Rice Millers Exporters Association** has urged the government to utilize a Rupee payment mechanism for commodity trade to facilitate this exchange.  The future of these imports remains uncertain, as U.S. sanctions could be reimposed in April.

recent_articles.title: Prime Minister Modi holds meeting with T.N. BJP leaders regarding election-related work - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** met with senior leaders of the **BJP** in Chennai to discuss the upcoming Assembly election in Tamil Nadu. The meeting included **Piyush Goyal**, **L. Murugan**, and other party officials, who briefed **Modi** on ongoing election preparations.  **Goyal** later released a "White Paper" criticizing the Tamil Nadu government's financial situation, accusing it of mismanagement and debt accumulation. **Modi** also met with music composer Ramesh Vinayakam in Chennai.

recent_articles.title: Jan Vishwas Bill: Commerce Ministry wants departments to consider withdrawing cases involving minor offences - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Commerce and Industry Ministry** is advising all departments to review pending court cases involving minor offences and consider withdrawing them in light of the Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Bill, 2026. The bill aims to decriminalize and rationalize about 1,000 minor offenses to improve the business environment and reduce judicial burden. **Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal** stated that an estimated five crore pending court cases relate to these offenses, many of which could have been avoided. He urged courts to close such cases based on the new provisions, promoting ease of living for citizens.

recent_articles.title: Bhupinder Hooda, AJL discharged in Panchkula land allotment case - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Bhupinder Singh Hooda** and the **Associated Journals Limited (AJL)** were discharged in a money laundering case by a special court in Panchkula on Friday, April 3, 2026. The court closed the **Enforcement Directorate’s (ED)** case after the Punjab and Haryana High Court previously set aside charges against them in a separate case.  The High Court had found that there was insufficient evidence to proceed with the case. The case stemmed from the re-allotment of a plot in Panchkula by the **Haryana Urban Development Authority** (now known as the **Haryana Shehri Vikas Pradhikaran**) to the AJL in 1982.

recent_articles.title: West Asia crisis: Government discusses ways to scale up production of induction heater - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Indian government** held a meeting on Friday, April 3, 2026, to discuss measures to boost production of induction heaters and compatible utensils due to increased demand following disruptions in LPG supply caused by the West Asia crisis.  Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal chaired the meeting which included senior officials from various departments including Power Secretary Pankaj Agarwal, Director General of Foreign Trade (DGFT) Lav Agarwal, and Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT) Secretary Amardeep Singh Bhatia. The government also exempted the import of critical petrochemical products from customs duty for three months to ensure supply stability in other sectors.

recent_articles.title: Parliament passes Jan Vishwas Amendment Bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Parliament** passed the Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Bill, 2026, amending 784 provisions in 79 central laws to decriminalize and rationalize minor offenses. The bill was passed in both houses of Parliament with a voice vote after Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal responded to discussions on the legislation. These amendments will help citizens and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs).

recent_articles.title: Modi plans FTA push with Europe this summer, fast-tracking implementation on cards - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** will prioritize European relations this summer, with travel plans including a visit to the **G-7 Summit** in France and meetings with EU officials.  The **EU Parliament** is discussing ratifying the **EU-India Free Trade Agreement**, which aims to boost trade between the two regions. The delegation from the **European Union** met with Indian officials, discussing ways to expedite the agreement's implementation.

recent_articles.title: Lok Sabha passes Jan Vishwas amendment Bill - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Lok Sabha** passed the Jan Vishwas (Amendment of Provisions) Bill, 2026, which aims to decriminalize and rationalize minor offenses for easier business and living. The bill proposes amendments to 79 Central Acts administered by 23 Ministries, seeking to remove outdated provisions and improve the regulatory environment.  Commerce and Industry Minister **Piyush Goyal** supported the bill, while Congress member **K. Kavya**'s amendments were rejected.

recent_articles.title: T.N. Assembly election: Vijay has no understanding of T.N. politics, says Piyush Goyal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Piyush Goyal**, **Union Minister for Commerce and Industry**, criticized the Tamil Nadu-based political party, **Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)**, stating that its leader, **C. Joseph Vijay**, lacks understanding of the state's people and culture.  Goyal compared Vijay to past actors who entered politics in Tamil Nadu and failed to gain significant support. He also dismissed the TVK as unlikely to secure any seats in the upcoming election, highlighting his belief that voters prefer a government led by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** and **Edappadi K. Palaniswami**.

recent_articles.title: BJP seeks action against Mamata over ‘MCC breach’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** filed a complaint with the **Election Commission of India (EC)** alleging violations of the Model Code of Conduct by West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee. The party accused Ms. Banerjee of making inflammatory statements, inciting violence, and undermining public confidence in the electoral process.  The BJP demanded legal action against Ms. Banerjee, including her debarment from campaigning, enhanced security measures, and increased EC observer deployment.

recent_articles.title: WTO’s fisheries pact: India for 25 year transition period, stronger disciplines on distant-water industrial fishing - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India** called for a 25-year transition period for developing countries, stricter regulations on distant-water industrial fishing fleets, and a permanent exemption for small-scale and artisanal fishers in the second phase of the WTO's fisheries subsidies agreement. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal emphasized that these priorities align with India's focus on food security and supporting its 9 million fisher families who primarily utilize sustainable practices.

recent_articles.title: Six leaders from Uttarakhand BJP join Congress as party steps up attack on Dhami-led government - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kumari Selja**, **Congress** general secretary and State in-charge, welcomed six leaders from the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** to the **Congress party** in New Delhi. The former **BJP** MLAs joining the **Congress** are Rajkumar Thukral, Narayan Pal, and Bhimlal Arya, along with Gaurav Goyal, Lakhan Singh, and Anuj Gupta.  **Selja** attributed the move to growing public dissatisfaction with the **BJP** government in **Uttarakhand**, citing corruption allegations and a lack of support for Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami's image.
